description: This file defines a RowIterator class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, used for iterating over rows within a worksheet. It implements PHP's Iterator interface and provides methods for controlling iteration over worksheet rows, such as resetStart, resetEnd, seek, rewind, current, key, next, prev, and valid.

classes.name: RowIterator
classes.description: Iterator for worksheet rows in PhpSpreadsheet, allowing iteration from start to end row with control methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RowIterator with a worksheet, optional start row, and optional end row.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that nullifies the worksheet reference.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Resets the starting row for iteration and seeks to that row.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Resets the end row for iteration.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current position to a specific row, with range validation.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the start row.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current Row object at the iterator's position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next row.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous row.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the start and end range.
